name: create_fiber_items_endpoint
description: Creates an in-memory Fiber REST endpoint for items
prompts: This Go module (go.mod/go.sum already list github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2 v2.52.5 as a dependency) needs a main.go. Using Fiber, implement an in-memory REST resource for /items: GET /items returns a JSON array of all items created so far (each with an integer `id` and a string `name`), and POST /items accepts a JSON body {"name": string} and creates a new item with an auto-incrementing integer id starting at 1, responding with 201 Created and the created item as JSON. Items only need to be stored in memory (no database). The server listens on port 8030.

import subprocess, sys, time, json, urllib.request, urllib.error

def req(method, path, body=None):
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    r = urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:8030{path}', data=data, method=method)
    if data is not None:
        r.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=3) as resp:
            payload = resp.read()
            return resp.status, (json.loads(payload) if payload else None)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        payload = e.read()
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(payload) if payload else None
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            parsed = None
        return e.code, parsed

subprocess.run(['go', 'build', '-o', 'app_bin', '.'], check=True)
srv = subprocess.Popen(['./app_bin'])
try:
    ok = False
    status = body = None
    for _ in range(30):
        try:
            status, body = req('GET', '/items')
            ok = True
            break
        except (urllib.error.URLError, ConnectionResetError):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    assert ok, 'server never became reachable on :8030'
    assert status == 200 and body == [], f'expected empty list, got {status} {body!r}'

    status, body = req('POST', '/items', {'name': 'widget'})
    assert status == 201, f'expected 201 on create, got {status} {body!r}'
    assert body.get('id') == 1 and body.get('name') == 'widget', f'unexpected created item: {body!r}'

    status, body = req('POST', '/items', {'name': 'gadget'})
    assert status == 201 and body.get('id') == 2, f'expected second item id 2, got {status} {body!r}'

    status, body = req('GET', '/items')
    assert status == 200, f'expected 200, got {status}'
    assert isinstance(body, list) and len(body) == 2, f'expected 2 items, got {body!r}'
    names = sorted(item['name'] for item in body)
    assert names == ['gadget', 'widget'], f'unexpected items: {body!r}'
finally:
    srv.terminate()
    try:
        srv.wait(timeout=5)
    except Exception:
        srv.kill()
print('PASS')
